Package index

License helpers

Validate, normalize, and verify CCLD facility license numbers.

ccld_pad()
Pad facility license numbers to the API's canonical 9-digit form
ccld_verify()
Verify CCLD facility license numbers in bulk

Facility detail

Pull detailed fields, visits, reports, and complaints for a single facility.

ccld_facility()
Pull the full CCLD facility detail for one license

Alameda snapshots

Fetch current Alameda County child-care facility snapshots by facility type.

ccld_alameda()
Live Alameda snapshot for a child-care facility type

Cache management

Inspect and clear cached Transparency API responses.

ccld_cache_info()
Inspect cached CCLD API responses
ccld_cache_clear()
Clear cached CCLD API responses
